plugin.name: zerospace-ring
plugin._long: One window holds the centre; the rest orbit it in Z-space.

option.name: rotate_left
option._long: Bring the previous window in the orbit to the centre.

option.name: rotate_right
option._long: Bring the next window in the orbit to the centre.

option.name: overview
option._long: Spread every window evenly round the full orbit.

option.name: cycle_width
option._long: Cycle the centre window through 33, 50, 67 and 100 percent of the screen.

option.name: maximize
option._long: Toggle the centre window between full width and 50 percent.

option.name: tile_width
option._long: Width of an orbiting tile, as a fraction of the screen width.

option.name: overview_width
option._long: Width of each window in the stalk-eye overview, as a fraction of the screen width.

option.name: centre_height
option._long: Height of the centre window, as a fraction of the screen height.

option.name: gap
option._long: Space in pixels kept between windows and the screen edge.
